{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Working class power is international or it is nothing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The system of capital confronts us and is thoroughly global, reaching beyond the boundaries of the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalist exploitation involves extraction in Africa, exploitation in Asia, and the propagation of urban slums throughout the Global South.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The system of global capitalism is not natural.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The system of global capitalism is enforced by the military might of the United States government.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The history of the US state is riddled with imperialism, slavery, genocide, and colonialism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American state developed as a terroristic capitalist formation.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today’s working class crosses all national borders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism is a global threat.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Only a globally organized working class is sufficient for fighting capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Collective opposition to the US government’s capacity to build empire and inflict imperialist violence stems from the development of class power through international solidarities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
